purpose: Graphical log: the leading inline icon of the "<Player> is stunned!" injury outcome row (tooltip "Stunned").
tool: Built-in image_gen (art lane, owner-supplied 10-15); the source is byte-identical to three-stars-square-v2.png, whose manifest beside it records the prompt (three gold stars, square game log icon). The stunned-v1.provenance.json beside the source describes an earlier STUNNED text image and does not match this file.
processing: Same pipeline as stalling.png: hidden RGB under alpha 0 zeroed, trimmed to the alpha bounds (1254x1254 -> 1230x1187), centred on a square canvas, premultiplied Lanczos downscale to 256x256 RGBA. No redraw or recolour.
note: No FUMBBL or Games Workshop material.
